tools.purpose: Read a DLL's export table and emit the .def that forwards every export to the original module, including ordinal-only exports, and diff two builds to show which forwarders a new version breaks.
tools.expect: export table, forwarder .def, and a drift table of added / removed / moved ordinals

notes: Read-only. Ordinals are read from AddressOfNameOrdinals, so ordinal-only exports are reported as NONAME rather than silently dropped; a proxy that misses them fails at load time.
